"""Local browser smoke test for the stock visualization page."""
import os, sys, json, time
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright

WS = '/Users/wangjinhua/Library/Caches/VistaExperiments/formal-task003-local-3x3-minimaxm3-20260823-02-resume-03-noskill-replicate-02/workspace'
OUT = WS + '/output'
URL = 'http://localhost:8765/index.html'

errors = []

def assertTrue(cond, msg):
    if not cond:
        errors.append(msg)
        print('FAIL:', msg)
    else:
        print(' ok :', msg)

def section(name):
    print('\n----', name, '----')

with sync_playwright() as p:
    browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True, args=['--no-sandbox'])
    context = browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 1400, 'height': 900})
    page = context.new_page()
    console_msgs = []
    page.on('console', lambda msg: console_msgs.append((msg.type, msg.text)))
    page.on('pageerror', lambda exc: console_msgs.append(('pageerror', str(exc))))

    page.goto(URL, wait_until='networkidle')
    page.wait_for_timeout(1500)

    section('HEAD / DOM')
    assertTrue(page.title() != '', 'title not empty')
    assertTrue(page.locator('#bubble-chart').count() == 1, 'bubble chart svg exists')
    assertTrue(page.locator('#stock-table').count() == 1, 'stock table exists')

    section('Bubble chart rendering')
    bubbles = page.locator('#bubble-chart circle.bubble')
    bubbles_count = bubbles.count()
    assertTrue(bubbles_count == 50, f'expected 50 bubbles, got {bubbles_count}')

    section('Sector colors / clustering')
    info = page.evaluate("""
        () => {
          const circles = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#bubble-chart circle.bubble'));
          const sectorByFill = {};
          circles.forEach(c => {
            const f = c.getAttribute('fill');
            sectorByFill[f] = (sectorByFill[f] || 0) + 1;
          });
          const rect = document.querySelector('#bubble-chart').getBoundingClientRect();
          const r = { cx: rect.left + rect.width/2, cy: rect.top + rect.height/2 };
          // compute approximate cluster centroids by sector color from data
          return { sectorByFill, r, count: circles.length };
        }
    """)
    print(' sectorByFill:', info['sectorByFill'])
    assertTrue(len([k for k in info['sectorByFill'].keys()]) >= 5, '5+ sector colors')

    section('Legend')
    legend_items = page.locator('#legend .legend-item').count()
    assertTrue(legend_items >= 5, f'>=5 legend items (got {legend_items})')
    legend_text = ' '.join([page.locator('#legend .legend-item').nth(i).inner_text() for i in range(legend_items)])
    for sector in ['Information Technology', 'Industry', 'Energy', 'Financial', 'ETF']:
        assertTrue(sector in legend_text, f'legend mentions "{sector}"')

    section('Data table')
    rows = page.locator('#stock-table tbody tr').count()
    assertTrue(rows == 50, f'50 rows in table (got {rows})')
    headers = [page.locator('#stock-table thead th').nth(i).inner_text().strip() for i in range(page.locator('#stock-table thead th').count())]
    print(' headers:', headers)
    assertTrue(any('Ticker' in h for h in headers), 'has Ticker symbol header')
    assertTrue(any('company' in h.lower() for h in headers), 'has Full company name header')
    assertTrue(any('Sector' in h for h in headers), 'has Sector header')
    assertTrue(any('Market' in h for h in headers), 'has Market cap header')

    section('Market cap formatting')
    sample_text = []
    for i in range(min(10, rows)):
        t = page.locator('#stock-table tbody tr').nth(i).inner_text()
        sample_text.append(t)
    text_blob = '\n'.join(sample_text)
    print(' first few rows:\n', text_blob[:600])
    has_T = any('T' in line.split('\t')[-1] or 'T' in line for line in sample_text)
    assertTrue(has_T, 'market cap text contains "T" suffix (trillion)')

    section('Tooltip on bubble hover (non-ETF)')
    # Pick a non-ETF bubble (e.g. AAPL)
    aapl = page.locator('[data-ticker="AAPL"] circle.bubble, [data-ticker="AAPL"]').first
    # hover the AAPL bubble
    page.locator('#bubble-chart [data-ticker="AAPL"]').hover()
    page.wait_for_timeout(300)
    tip = page.locator('#tooltip').inner_text()
    print(' tooltip text:', repr(tip))
    assertTrue('AAPL' in tip, 'tooltip has ticker')
    assertTrue('Apple' in tip, 'tooltip has company name')
    assertTrue('Information Technology' in tip, 'tooltip has sector')

    section('Tooltip skipped for ETF')
    page.locator('#bubble-chart [data-ticker="SPY"]').hover()
    page.wait_for_timeout(300)
    is_hidden = page.evaluate("() => document.getElementById('tooltip').classList.contains('visible') === false || document.getElementById('tooltip').offsetParent === null || document.getElementById('tooltip').style.opacity === '0'")
    print(' ETF tooltip hidden:', is_hidden)
    assertTrue(is_hidden, 'ETF tooltip does not show')

    section('Bubble <-> Row linking')
    # click bubble -> row highlighted
    page.locator('#bubble-chart [data-ticker="MSFT"]').click()
    page.wait_for_timeout(200)
    selected_row_exists = page.locator('#stock-table tr.selected').count() == 1
    selected_row_ticker = page.evaluate("() => { const tr=document.querySelector('#stock-table tr.selected'); return tr?tr.getAttribute('data-ticker'):null; }")
    print(' row ticker after bubble click:', selected_row_ticker)
    assertTrue(selected_row_exists and selected_row_ticker == 'MSFT', 'clicking MSFT bubble selects MSFT row')

    # click another row -> bubble selected
    page.locator('#stock-table tr[data-ticker="JPM"]').click()
    page.wait_for_timeout(200)
    bubble_selected = page.evaluate("() => { const c=document.querySelector('#bubble-chart circle.bubble.selected'); return c?c.parentElement.getAttribute('data-ticker'):null; }")
    print(' bubble ticker after row click:', bubble_selected)
    assertTrue(bubble_selected == 'JPM', 'clicking JPM row selects JPM bubble')

    section('Console errors')
    for kind, text in console_msgs:
        if kind in ('error', 'pageerror'):
            print(' console', kind, ':', text)
    assertTrue(not [m for m in console_msgs if m[0] in ('pageerror',)], 'no page errors')

    browser.close()

if errors:
    print('\n=== FAIL ===')
